records.statement: Tax hikes on cigarettes choke demand, so fewer people smoke.
Echo chambers amplify views online, so political polarization deepens.
Money is the root of all evil, so greed should be curbed.
Radiation raises cancer risk, so nuclear waste must be stored securely.
Mercury accumulates in fish, so pregnant women should limit tuna consumption.
Sugary drinks raise diabetes risk, so schools should not sell them.
Fatigue increases human error, so pilots' consecutive flight hours should be limited.
Nuclear power emits little carbon, so it should replace fossil fuel plants.
Asteroid impacts can cause extinctions, so nations should fund planetary defense programs.
Since fluoride strengthens teeth, cities should add it to public water.
US presidents face term limits, so none can legally win a third term.
Copyright eventually expires, so very old novels can be republished by anyone.
Journalism ethics forbid fabrication, so reporters who invent quotes are often fired.
Ballots are secret by law, so employers cannot demand to see employees' votes.
Lawyers owe clients confidentiality, so they generally cannot disclose client secrets.
Sugar is a silent thief of teeth, so children should brush twice daily.
UV rays are invisible bullets, so wear sunscreen to prevent skin cancer.
Excess salt is a slow poison for arteries, so limit your sodium.
Since propaganda poisons public discourse, schools should teach media literacy.
Earth's resources will dwindle, so humanity should reach for the stars.
Ice sheets are melting, so ignoring sea-level rise is fiddling while Rome burns.
The moon is the ocean's puppeteer, since its gravity pulls the tides.
The heart is a tireless pump, beating billions of times because muscle never rests.
Because privacy protects freedom, governments should not collect citizens' data without warrants.
Since monopolies harm consumers, governments should break up giant tech companies.
Sunlight takes eight minutes to reach Earth, so we see the Sun's past.
Sea fossils found on mountains show those rocks were once underwater.
Viruses lack their own cell machinery, so they must infect cells to reproduce.
Radioactive decay rates are constant, so isotopes can be used to date rocks.
Venus's thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat, making it hotter than Mercury.
Most democracies require citizens to be at least eighteen to vote.
Most legal systems presume a defendant innocent until proven guilty.
In most countries, being married to two spouses simultaneously is illegal.
Because rent control limits landlord profits, it will shrink the housing supply.
Entropy is the tax the universe charges, so waste nothing.
Genes load the gun, but lifestyle pulls the trigger.
The stars are humanity's next shore; we should keep sailing toward them.
Wealthy people should pay higher taxes.
The death penalty is morally wrong.
Honesty in politicians matters more than their charisma.
Nations should welcome refugees fleeing war.
Animals deserve legal protection from cruelty.
A minimum wage should allow workers to live decently.
Religious freedom must be protected by law.
Prisons should focus on rehabilitation rather than punishment.
Small leaks sink great ships, so fix cracks promptly.
Doctors should not prescribe antibiotics for viral infections.
Adults should get at least seven hours of sleep each night.
Normans ruled England for centuries, so English contains many French-derived words.
Businesses cut spending during recessions, so unemployment usually rises.
Wartime governments boost military spending, so civilian programs often receive less funding.
Higher education raises average earnings, so college graduates typically out-earn non-graduates.
In courts of law, justice is blind: all stand equal before it.
Attorney-client privilege locks a client's secrets behind a legal wall.
Double jeopardy law denies prosecutors a second bite at the apple.
Smokers should quit because smoking greatly raises lung cancer risk.
Money talks loudly in modern election campaigns.
Celebrity endorsements give sales a big boost.
Wealthier countries tend to have lower birth rates than poorer countries.
Most countries require children to attend school.
Mandarin Chinese has more native speakers than any other language.
The United Nations has nearly two hundred member states.
People with more education tend to earn higher incomes.
Voter turnout in the US is higher in presidential than midterm elections.
English is the most widely studied foreign language in the world.
A rising tide lifts all boats.
Culture eats strategy for breakfast.
Water molecules are made of hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
Earthquakes are caused by moving tectonic plates.
Light travels much faster than sound.
A major earthquake will strike California within the next few decades.
Human life expectancy will continue to increase over the next century.
Quantum computers will eventually outperform classical computers at most tasks.
Electric cars will outnumber gasoline cars on the road by 2050.
Light sets the universe's ultimate speed limit.
Earth's atmosphere is a blanket that traps heat and keeps us warm.
Immigration raises wages for native-born workers overall.
Remote work makes employees more productive.
Most voters are poorly informed about government policy.
Rent control reduces the supply of available housing.
He never calls back, so the ball's in his court; stop chasing.
Kids are sponges, so parents should watch their language at home.
Your spine isn't a crane, so lift with your legs.
Wild mushrooms are dice rolls, so eat only what experts approve.
Don't play with fire, because flames will burn your hands every time.
Wet floors are slippery, so walk on eggshells after mopping.
Milk sours in warm rooms, so refrigerate it before it turns into cheese.
Cars need fuel, so fill up before you're running on fumes.
Heavy boxes strain backs, so lift with your legs or break your back.
Toddlers mouth everything, so keep coins away from those little vacuum cleaners.
Fresh coffee scalds tongues, so let it cool before you drink lava.
Sleep loss slows reflexes, so don't drive when you're dead on your feet.
Loud music damages hearing, so turn it down before your ears ring like church bells.
It's my coworker's birthday, so I should sign her card.
The neighbor's music is loud at midnight, so asking them to stop is reasonable.
Guests are arriving soon, so I should tidy the living room.

The milk smells sour, so you should not drink it.
That spot has a disability sign, so parking there requires a permit.
The package is addressed to your neighbor, so you should not open it.
The invitation asks for an RSVP by Friday, so you should reply by then.
She aced every interview round, so the job is practically in the bag.
The road is a sheet of glass, so cars will skid when braking.
Snow buried the car overnight, so it must be dug out before driving.
The movie sold out quickly, so most viewers will probably enjoy it.
She burned her bridges at work, so no one will give her references.
He's all bark and no bite, so his threats won't lead anywhere.
The squeaky wheel gets the grease, so complain loudly for better service.
Kids are sponges, so they'll repeat whatever swear words you use.
The bread is a brick, so it must have been baked days ago.
The baby is a ticking bomb; she skipped her nap, so a meltdown looms.
The plant got no water for weeks, so it wilted.
The bread sat out for two weeks, so it grew mold.
The light bulb burned out, so the lamp gives no light.
The balloon touched the cactus spines, so it popped.
The candle burned for hours, so it is shorter than before.
Today is Sunday, so tomorrow is Monday.
It is December 24th, so tomorrow is Christmas Day.
The store closes at nine, so at ten its doors are locked.
He is the youngest child, so his siblings are all older than him.
School is out for summer, so the kids are not attending classes.
The receipt lists two coffees, so we were charged for two drinks.
Never air your dirty laundry in public.
A borrowed book should come home like a lost child.
Don't burn the candle at both ends.
Strike while the iron is hot.
Students are expected to raise their hands before speaking in class.
In Western cultures, wedding guests are expected not to wear white.
Moviegoers are expected to silence their phones during films in theaters.
Houseplants should be watered about once a week.
Steak should be cooked medium rare for the best taste.
It is polite to offer elderly people your seat on the bus.
You should dress neatly for a job interview.
You should wash your hands before eating to remove germs.
You should not pour water on a grease fire.
Don't put all your eggs in one basket with your savings.
Give credit where credit is due in group projects.
Mosquitoes always find the one patch of bare skin.
Rush hour turns the highway into a giant parking lot.
Oil and water don't mix.
Neighbors who say hello make a street feel safer.
Most people dislike phone calls from unknown numbers.
First dates are awkward for most people.
Oil floats on top of water.
In the United States, cars drive on the right side of the road.
The US Postal Service does not deliver regular mail on Sundays.
Tomorrow morning will be colder than today.
Humid heat feels worse than dry heat.
Wool sweaters feel too itchy against bare skin.
The ocean is too cold for swimming in May.
Roses smell sweeter than lilies.
My houseplant will bloom again next spring.
